subject: SOC 2 recheck: evidence handoff, SLA ask, and seat uplift plan
messages:
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@healthbridge.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@healthbridge.com
Date: Tue, 11 Jul 2028 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal + SOC 2 re-attestation window and seat increase ask

Hi Priya / Ben,

We’re coming up on our annual contract renewal for HealthBridge (current term ends 2028-08-31). Procurement asked me to consolidate two asks into one thread: 1) HealthBridge needs Redwood’s SOC 2 re-attestation materials for our renewal packet (procurement wants the most recent evidence indexes, system descriptions, and log retention policy), and 2) we’re planning a 30% seat uplift starting with the new term due to an expanded pilot across two additional regions.

Procurement timeline: they want evidence and the proposed amendment to review by EOD Friday 2028-07-15. Can you confirm what you can provide and whether Redwood can extend log retention for our account to a 90-day audit window (we currently see 30 days listed)? Also flag any pricing implication for the seat uplift — procurement will need a committed monthly rate and the amendment doc for review.

I attached a short renewal request summary for reference.

Thanks —
Sanjay
Sanjay Rao
Head of IT Operations, HealthBridge
[Attachment: HealthBridge_Renewal_Request.pdf (pdf)]

From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@healthbridge.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 Jul 2028 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + SOC 2 re-attestation window and seat increase ask

Hi Sanjay — thanks for the clear asks. Looping in Ben for pricing/contract amendment and Grace for the SOC 2 evidence/retention details. High-level plan:

- Security: we will stage a minimized SOC 2 evidence bundle (index + redacted artifacts) by Thu 2028-07-13 for your procurement review; Grace will confirm exact artifacts and retention changes.
- Terms & Pricing: Ben will propose a seat amendment and a 90-day audit window delta. We can propose a one-time seat uplift amendment (monthly commitment) or a graduated seat tier — Ben, please advise.
- Delivery: we’ll upload evidence to a secure share and send a DocuSign for the amendment; I’ll include a summary tracker for procurement to speed review.

Can you confirm procurement’s preferred DocuSign signer (Maya or an SSO procurement mailbox)? We’ll aim for the EOD 7/15 target but will flag anything that blocks earlier.

— Priya
Priya Natarajan
Account Lead, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference | priya@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0199

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@healthbridge.com>, Priya Narianjan <priya@redwood.ai>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 Jul 2028 11:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + SOC 2 re-attestation window and seat increase ask

Hi Sanjay — thanks, I’ll own the amendment and pricing. Quick notes:

- Seat uplift: 30% uplift on current committed seats. If HealthBridge prefers a one-time add vs. an increased committed tier, both are possible:
  * One-time add (no long-term commitment): +30% billed as one-off monthly charge for first month, then reverts to current commit.
  * Commit uplift: +30% new committed baseline with a 10% volume discount applied to the incremental seats for a minimum 12-month term.
- Pricing impact: Ballpark incremental ARR impact: $34k–$46k depending on whether you take the commit uplift. I’ll send a clean amendment PDF and a comparison table by EOD.
- DocuSign: confirm signer as Maya Singh (maya.singh@healthbridge.com) and we’ll route to procurement mailbox for countersignature.

Attaching draft amendment (protected) for internal review; I’ll finalize language for the SLA/retention clause once Grace confirms feasibility for 90-day audit retention.

— Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: RBW_seat_amendment_1.0.pdf (pdf)]

From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@healthbridge.com>, Priya Narianjan <priya@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 12 Jul 2028 08:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + SOC 2 re-attestation window and seat increase ask

Hi all — Grace from Security here. Quick technical summary and what we’ll provide: 

- Evidence bundle: We’ll prepare a SOC 2 evidence index (REDWOOD_SOC2_EVIDENCE_INDEX.xlsx) plus a set of redacted artifacts (system descriptions, control narratives, example logs). Expect the index + sample artifacts by Thu 2028-07-13.
- Log retention: Current default for Hosted customers is 30 days for application-level request logs and 90 days for meta/observability logs. For HealthBridge we can offer a 90-day audit window for the account’s security logs as an account-level config for the new term; there is an operational cost impact and we’ve proposed that in the amendment.
- Staging: We will upload the evidence bundle to a secure drive link (pre-auth) and share a checklist for procurement. Please note we will redact customer-identifying PII from artifacts before upload.

Action items from security:
1) Upload evidence index & sample artifacts by 2028-07-13 morning.
2) Block time with HealthBridge for a 30-min walkthrough if procurement requests — I’m available Thu 7/13 10–12 or Fri 7/14 14–16 PT.
3) Confirm acceptance of 90-day audit window (Ben/Priya will confirm commercially).

Date: Fri, 13 Jul 2028 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + SOC 2 re-attestation window and seat increase ask

Appreciate the fast turnaround — this looks good. A few quick confirmations from procurement: 

- Procurement confirmed Maya Singh is the signer and will route to the procurement mailbox for countersignature once we receive the DocuSign.
- The 90-day audit window is acceptable if it’s explicitly called out in the amendment and shows any recurring fee line. Procurement wants the amendment PDF + redwood’s evidence index by close of business today (7/13).
- We’d like a short (30 min) walkthrough of the evidence bundle Thurs 7/13 at 11:00 PT if Grace is available — procurement will use that session to mark any missing artifacts.

If you can upload the index and a link to the DocuSign now, we’ll kick off internal review.

Thanks —
Sanjay
